Method of Attack: Path traversal vulnerability via rspamd_maps() function allowing arbitrary file overwrite and command execution
Cross-site scripting (XSS) via unsanitized exception handling mechanism leading to session hijacking and privileged actions
Attack Vector: Overwriting files modifiable by www-data user
Injection of malicious scripts into the admin panel via crafted input
Indicators of Compromise: HTML email containing a CSS background image loaded from a remote URL to trigger XSS payload
